title: Head bounds after halting
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$, and let $a,B$ be natural numbers. If the run from $c$ has halted by time $a$, and every configuration reached at a time $u\le a$ has all work-tape heads in $[-B,B]$, then every configuration reached from $c$ at any natural time has all work-tape heads in $[-B,B]$.
